summary: Cultus Mountain lookout, Deschutes National Forest, Oregon: a 1935 tower replaced in 1958, removed by 1968 per two sources; now gone.

facts.design: 20-foot round tower with a 10x10 foot L-5 cabin (1935), replaced in 1958 by a 20-foot treated timber tower with an R-6 cab
facts.status_note: Two pages say the lookout is gone; none we read describes what, if anything, remains on the summit.
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Deschutes National Forest

events.note: Listed only by the register and firelookout.com: a 20-foot tower of 9 by 9 feet. The Deschutes blog and Oregon Lookouts page start with the 1935 tower.
A newspaper notice said a telephone line would reach Cultus Mountain, which would be developed as an emergency lookout
20-foot round tower with a 10x10 foot L-5 cabin; the Oregon Lookouts page gives the cost as $947.24
Forest officials announced a lookout house for the peak; bids for it were rejected as too high
20-foot treated timber tower with an R-6 cab replaced the 1935 tower; the successful bidder had to remove the old lookout buildings
Abandoned, per the register and firelookout.com
Removal of the 1958 tower per the Deschutes County blog (which dates the 1935 tower's removal to 1958); the Oregon Lookouts page dates the surplus sale, stripping and burning of the lookout to 1968

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com list a 1925 tower of 9 by 9 feet. The Deschutes blog and the Oregon Lookouts page begin with the 1935 tower and do not mention 1925. The story reports both, with the 1925 date attributed to those two listings.

The register and firelookout.com say it was abandoned in 1963. The Deschutes blog gives 1968 as the removal year, and the Oregon Lookouts page says it was sold as surplus, stripped and burned in 1968. The story gives both dates.

notes_for_editor: Four pages, no photos with usable URLs (the register credits a Rex Kamstra photo with no link). The 1957-58 details are newspaper excerpts transcribed on the Oregon Lookouts page (The Bend Bulletin, The Oregonian); not checked against the originals. Dates conflict on the 1925 tower and on 1963 vs 1968; the story gives both. No source describes the summit today. Staffing and fire history not found, so left out.
